use_when.statement: Use field to wrap any input control with a label, an optional required mark and helper or error text — used by Input, Select, Textarea and Checkbox groups alike.
use_when.verbatim: Use field to wrap any input control with a label, an optional required mark and helper or error text — used by Input, Select, Textarea and Checkbox groups alike.

dont_use_when.verbatim: Don’t write the field’s own error styling into the control; field carries it.

placement.statement: in a form, wrapping one input control

a11y.fact: renders exactly one <label> whose htmlFor points at the caller own control, so the label and the control are genuinely associated
htmlFor is omitted entirely when no control has been named, rather than writing an empty reference
in the error state the helper row becomes role="alert", so a validation message is announced when it appears
the required asterisk is aria-hidden and the announced word is in a screen-reader-only span, so "required" is read rather than "star"
